channel.title: Nicotine Science and Policy
channel.description: Daily digest of views, debates and discussions on nicotine science, policy, regulation and advocacy.

item.title: Spain's Proposed Vape Flavour Ban Risks More Smoking and a Booming Black Market, New Survey Finds
item.description: Spain's proposed vape flavour ban could have unintended consequences for smoking cessation, according to a new consumer survey conducted among 500 adult vapers. (Published on November 17, 2026byprohibitiondoesnotwork.com)

item.title: Smoking in, vaping out: The social trend worrying health experts
item.description: Smoking is becoming more socially acceptable, while vaping faces growing disapproval, according to new research involving nearly 20,000 adults across Australia, Canada, England and the United States. (Published on November 17, 2026bymedicalxpress.com)

item.title: European Parliament nicotine event access row raises Article 5.3 questions
item.description: A European Parliament event examining the science of emerging nicotine products has faced criticism after several tobacco harm reduction advocates reported being denied access. (Published on November 17, 2026byclearingtheair.eu)

item.title: Setback for EU tobacco laws – Health Commissioner claims that smoke
item.description: The EU's tobacco reform faces fresh uncertainty after the European Commission's Regulatory Scrutiny Board reportedly issued a negative opinion on the legislation's impact assessment, potentially delaying the revised Tobacco Products Directive until 2027. (Published on November 17, 2026byvejpkollen.se)

item.title: More than 80% of Irish people support lifetime smoking ban
item.description: A lifetime smoking ban is being discussed in Ireland as part of efforts to prevent future generations from taking up cigarettes. (Published on November 17, 2026bynewstalk.com)
